rule_description: Birth date must not be in the future
Birth date must not be before 1800 unless historical dataset
Death date must be on or after birth date
validation_query: death_date IS NULL OR death_date >= birth_date

rule_description: Birth latitude must be in range [-90, 90]
Birth longitude must be in range [-180, 180]
Timezone offset must be in range [-720, +840] minutes
Event date must be on or after birth date
validation_query: event_date >= (SELECT birth_date FROM birth_charts WHERE id = events.chart_id)

rule_description: Event date must be on or before death date if both present
validation_query: death_date IS NULL OR event_date <= death_date

rule_description: created_at must be on or before updated_at
All enum fields must contain values from declared set
Duration values must not be negative
Country code must be valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
Sequence numbers must be unique within dataset
Record IDs must be unique within dataset
Cross-referenced record IDs must exist in target dataset
Planet longitude must be in range [0, 360) degrees
Planet latitude must be in range [-90, 90] degrees
Sidereal longitude must equal tropical longitude minus ayanamsa
Planet rashi must match floor(sidereal_longitude / 30)
Rashi degree must be in range [0, 30) degrees
House number must be in range [1, 12]
Nakshatra number must be in range [1, 27]
Pada number must be in range [1, 4]
Dasha end date must be after start date
Child dasha dates must be contained within parent dasha dates
validation_query: parent_id IS NULL OR (start_date >= parent.start_date AND end_date <= parent.end_date)
